description: The person's Selfie from their evidence package, read from their own words through the KSA Dictionary by pattern matching, with no AI: the same package gives the same Selfie. The seven dimensions (skills, knowledge, abilities and more) as the evidence shows them. Each item quotes the words it was read from, or names the course row or life experience, names the document and the Dictionary entry that placed it, and carries one of five governed bands (emerging signal, plausible, supported, strongly supported, corroborated candidate) with the basis that put it there; its level (Bloom, Dreyfus or O*NET Level) is a separate field. A transcript's courses are read as their held learning units. Program (CIP) and occupation (SOC) codes are reached by crossing, each with its chain; O*NET's elements for those occupations come as candidates with O*NET's published Importance and Level, never as shown. With the Selfie come an affirmation for each dimension the evidence supports and a first-person positional statement (with the aspiration, when given), naming only the person's own items and documents and saying "may". It mirrors, for the person to confirm, refine or reject; it is never a grade or a credit decision. The person's placements and dismissals in the package's selfie.learner_decisions are honored. Nothing is stored: the answer returns the package with the Selfie for the agent to keep.

aspiration.description: Optional: what the person is aiming for; the positional statement reads it

package.description: The goldribbon_package_v1 object an earlier GoldRibbon answer returned. Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.
